arguments.command:
cat > /app/work/semtest.py << 'PYEOF'
import json, subprocess, sys

def run(req):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '/app/submission/main.py'],
                       input=json.dumps(req).encode(), capture_output=True)
    assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr.decode()
    return json.loads(p.stdout.decode())

def flag_schema(names):
    return [{'name': n, 'type': 'FLAG'} for n in names]

def atom_eq(name, val, at=0):
    return {'cmp': 'eq', 'left': {'field': name, 'at': at},
            'right': {'const': val, 'type': 'FLAG'}}

def trace(tid, src, rows):
    return {'id': tid, 'source': src, 'rows': rows}

def row(t, vals):
    return {'t': t, 'values': vals}

fails = []
def check(label, got, expect):
    if got != expect:
        fails.append(label)
        print('FAIL', label)
        print('  got   ', json.dumps(got))
        print('  expect', json.dumps(expect))
    else:
        print('ok  ', label)

# ---- 1. per-source support kills every literal ----
req = {'version': 1, 'schema': flag_schema(['f']), 'window': 1,
       'atoms': [atom_eq('f', True), atom_eq('f', False)],
       'policy': {'max_width': 2, 'min_support': 2, 'min_witness': 1},
       'train': [trace('a', 's1', [row(0, [True]), row(1, [True]), row(2, [True])]),
                 trace('b', 's2', [row(0, [False]), row(1, [False]), row(2, [False])])],
       'probes': [trace('p', 's1', [row(0, [True])])],
       'queries': []}
check('per-source support kills all', run(req), {'version': 1, 'classes': [], 'queries': []})

# ---- 2. witnesses are per-source ----
req = {'version': 1, 'schema': flag_schema(['f', 'g']), 'window': 1,
       'atoms': [atom_eq('f', True), atom_eq('g', True)],
       'policy': {'max_width': 2, 'min_support': 1, 'min_witness': 1},
       'train': [trace('a', 's1', [row(0, [True, True]), row(1, [True, False])]),
                 trace('b', 's2', [row(0, [True, True]), row(1, [False, True])])],
       'probes': [trace('p', 's1', [row(0, [False, False])])],
       'queries': []}
r = run(req)
# eligible singletons {a0},{a1}; {a0,a1} lacks a witness in s2 for both literals
check('witness per-source', (len(r['classes']), [c['members'] for c in r['classes']]),
      (2, [1, 1]))

# ---- 3. same but with witness threshold satisfied in both sources ----
req['train'] = [trace('a', 's1', [row(0, [True, True]), row(1, [True, False])]),
                trace('b', 's2', [row(0, [True, True]), row(1, [False, True]),
                                  row(2, [True, False])])]
r = run(req)
sigs = sorted((c['signature'], c['members']) for c in r['classes'])
check('witness satisfied', sigs, [('0', 1), ('1', 3)])

# ---- 4. zero-context training source blocks everything ----
req = {'version': 1, 'schema': flag_schema(['f']), 'window': 3,
       'atoms': [atom_eq('f', True)],
       'policy': {'max_width': 1, 'min_support': 1, 'min_witness': 1},
       'train': [trace('a', 'sA', [row(0, [True]), row(1, [False])]),
                 trace('b', 'sB', [row(0, [True]), row(1, [True]), row(2, [True]),
                                   row(3, [True])])],
       'probes': [trace('p', 'sB', [row(0, [True]), row(1, [True]), row(2, [True])])],
       'queries': [trace('q', 'sB', [row(0, [False]), row(1, [True]), row(2, [True])])]}
r = run(req)
check('zero-context source', r, {'version': 1, 'classes': [],
      'queries': [{'trace': 'q', 'end': 2, 'must': 0, 'may': 0, 'status': 'consistent'}]})

# ---- 5. tautology rejected by condition 5 ----
req = {'version': 1, 'schema': flag_schema(['f']), 'window': 1,
       'atoms': [atom_eq('f', True), atom_eq('f', False)],
       'policy': {'max_width': 2, 'min_support': 1, 'min_witness': 1},
       'train': [trace('a', 's1', [row(0, [True]), row(1, [False])])],
       'probes': [trace('p', 's1', [row(0, [True]), row(1, [False])])],
       'queries': [trace('q', 's1', [row(0, [True])])]}
r = run(req)
# {a0} support: s1 has 1 true context >= S=1, witness 1 >= 1, but is it false on a probe? yes (row1)
# {a1} likewise. {a0,a1} tautology -> rejected. {~a0,~a1} tautology -> rejected.
check('tautology rejected', sorted((c['signature'], c['members']) for c in r['classes']),
      [('0', 1), ('1', 1)])

# ---- 6. probe signature grouping with P=5 ----
req = {'version': 1, 'schema': flag_schema(['f']), 'window': 1,
       'atoms': [atom_eq('f', True)],
       'policy': {'max_width': 1, 'min_support': 1, 'min_witness': 1},
       'train': [trace('a', 's1', [row(i, [True]) for i in range(3)])],
       'probes': [trace('p', 's1', [row(i, [i % 2 == 0]) for i in range(5)])],
       'queries': []}
r = run(req)
# probe contexts (K=1): T,F,T,F,T -> clause true at 0,2,4 -> bits 0,2,4 = 1+4+16 = 21 = 0x15
check('signature P=5', [(c['signature'], c['members']) for c in r['classes']], [('15', 1)])

# ---- 7. queries with duplicate atom patterns share counts ----
req = {'version': 1, 'schema': flag_schema(['f']), 'window': 1,
       'atoms': [atom_eq('f', True), atom_eq('f', False)],
       'policy': {'max_width': 2, 'min_support': 1, 'min_witness': 1},
       'train': [trace('a', 's1', [row(0, [True]), row(1, [False])])],
       'probes': [trace('p', 's1', [row(0, [True]), row(1, [False])])],
       'queries': [trace('q', 's1', [row(0, [True]), row(1, [True]), row(2, [False]),
                                     row(3, [True])])]}
r = run(req)
# both clauses eligible; class signature "0" (probe true on context0 for a0? probe rows T,F:
#   a0 true at ctx0 -> bit0=1; a1 true at ctx1 -> bit1=1 -> two classes: "1" and "2")
# query: ctx0 (T): a0 T, a1 F -> class "1" (a0) all members true -> must0 may0;
#        class "2" (a1) member false -> must1 may1 -> violating
# ctx1 (F): reverse. ctx2 (F) same as ctx1. ctx3 (T) same as ctx0.
check('duplicate patterns', [(c['signature'], c['members']) for c in sorted(r['classes'], key=lambda c: c['signature'])],
      [('1', 1), ('2', 1)])
check('duplicate query counts',
      [(q['must'], q['may'], q['status']) for q in r['queries']],
      [(0, 0, 'consistent'), (1, 1, 'violating'), (1, 1, 'violating'), (0, 0, 'consistent')])

# ---- 8. window > 1 contexts and quantifier atoms ----
req = {'version': 1, 'schema': flag_schema(['f']), 'window': 3,
       'atoms': [{'quantifier': 'all', 'from': 0, 'to': 2,
                  'predicate': {'cmp': 'eq', 'left': {'field': 'f', 'at': '$'},
                                'right': {'const': True, 'type': 'FLAG'}}},
                 {'quantifier': 'any', 'from': 0, 'to': 2,
                  'predicate': {'cmp': 'eq', 'left': {'field': 'f', 'at': '$'},
                                'right': {'const': True, 'type': 'FLAG'}}}],
       'policy': {'max_width': 2, 'min_support': 1, 'min_witness': 1},
       'train': [trace('a', 's1', [row(i, [v]) for i, v in enumerate([True, True, True, False])])],
       'probes': [trace('p', 's1', [row(0, [False]), row(1, [False]), row(2, [False])])],
       'queries': [trace('q', 's1', [row(0, [True]), row(1, [False]), row(2, [True])])]}
r = run(req)
# train contexts (K=3): rows0-2 [T,T,T] -> a0=T,a1=T ; rows1-3 [T,T,F] -> a0=F,a1=T
# cond2: a0 true in 1 ctx >=1 ok; ~a0 true in 1 ctx ok; a1 true in 2 ok; ~a1 true in 0 -> fails
# clauses: {a0}: true on ctx0 only -> not all -> rejected. {~a0}: rejected. {a1}: true on both -> ok,
#   witness 2>=1, probe: a1 false on probe -> eligible. {a0,a1}: true everywhere? ctx1: a0 F,a1 T -> ok;
#   witnesses: a0: ctx0 only (a1 true there) -> 0 -> rejected. {~a0,a1}: true everywhere;
#   witness ~a0: ctx1 (a1 true) -> 0 -> rejected. {a0,~a0}: same atom twice -> not generated.
check('quantifier windows', [(c['signature'], c['members']) for c in r['classes']], [('0', 1)])
# query context [T,F,T]: a0=F (not all true), a1=T -> class {a1} member true -> must0 may0 consistent
check('quantifier query', [(q['must'], q['may'], q['status']) for q in r['queries']],
      [(0, 0, 'consistent')])

print()
print('semantic tests: %d failures' % len(fails))
PYEOF
cd /app/work && python3 semtest.py
